OK — Connexion réussie. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] Le fournisseur a répondu normalement.

Erreur — Facturation / crédits / quota. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] Cela signifie généralement l'absence de moyen de paiement, un solde vide ou un quota dépassé (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenCode Zen, etc.). [DETAIL]Solution : ajoutez la facturation/des crédits dans le tableau de bord du fournisseur, ou passez à un modèle gratuit/moins cher.

Erreur — Problème du fournisseur (modèle indisponible). Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] La clé/URL semblent OK, mais le modèle en amont est hors service ou temporairement indisponible. [DETAIL]Solution : réessayez plus tard ou choisissez un autre modèle du même fournisseur.

Erreur — Nom de modèle invalide. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] L'ID du modèle a été rejeté par le fournisseur (introuvable / non pris en charge). [DETAIL]Solution : utilisez un ID de modèle exact depuis la documentation du fournisseur (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenCode Zen ou votre API personnalisée).

Erreur — Clé API rejetée. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] HTTP [STATUS]. La clé est absente, invalide, expirée ou non autorisée. [DETAIL]Solution : créez/collez une clé valide pour ce fournisseur (clé secrète OpenAI, x-api-key Anthropic, clé OpenCode Zen ou jeton personnalisé).

Erreur — Accès interdit. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] HTTP [STATUS]. La clé est valide, mais ce compte/cette organisation/région ne peut pas utiliser ce modèle ou cet endpoint. [DETAIL]Solution : vérifiez les permissions d'organisation, l'accès au modèle et les restrictions régionales dans le tableau de bord du fournisseur.

Erreur — Fournisseur surchargé. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] Le fournisseur est sous forte charge (courant avec Anthropic overloaded_error et les passerelles saturées). [DETAIL]Solution : attendez un instant et retestez.

Erreur — Limite de requêtes (rate limit). Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] HTTP [STATUS]. Trop de requêtes ou de tokens en peu de temps. [DETAIL]Solution : attendez quelques secondes et retestez, ou augmentez les limites de débit sur le compte du fournisseur.

Erreur — Requête invalide. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] HTTP [STATUS]. La forme de la requête a été rejetée (champs incorrects, paramètres non pris en charge ou style d'API incompatible). [DETAIL]Solution : confirmez que l'URL de base et le type de fournisseur (OpenAI chat vs Anthropic messages) correspondent à votre endpoint.

Erreur — Mauvaise URL / endpoint. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] HTTP [STATUS]. Réponse HTML ou non-API au lieu de JSON. [DETAIL]Solution : définissez l'URL de base sur la racine de l'API (ex. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.anthropic.com, https://opencode.ai/zen/v1).

Erreur — Réseau / DNS / TLS. Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Impossible d'atteindre le fournisseur (connexion, DNS, délai d'attente ou problème de certificat). [DETAIL]Solution : vérifiez l'accès Internet, le pare-feu/proxy, et que l'hôte de l'URL de base est correct.
Erreur — Serveur du fournisseur (HTTP [STATUS]). Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Échec temporaire côté fournisseur. [DETAIL]Solution : réessayez dans quelques minutes.
Erreur — Échec de connexion (HTTP [STATUS]). Fournisseur : [PROVIDER] Modèle : [MODEL] [DETAIL]Solution : vérifiez l'URL de base, l'ID du modèle, la clé API et le type de fournisseur.

integer llAgentInExperience(key agent) Returns a boolean (an integer) that is TRUE if the agent is in the experience and the experience can run in the current region.

llAttachToAvatarTemp(integer attach_point) Attaches the object to the avatar who has granted permission to the script, with the exception that the object will not create new inventory for the user, and will disappear on detach or disconnect.

key llCreateKeyValue(string k, string v) Start an asynchronous transaction to create a key-value pair associated with the given experience key using the given key and value. v is the value for the key-value pair. Maximum 2047 characters, or 4095 if using Mono.
Returns a handle (a key) that can be used to identify the corresponding dataserver event to determine if this command succeeded or failed.

key llDataSizeKeyValue() Start an asynchronous transaction to request the used and total amount of data allocated for the experience.
Returns a handle (a key) that can be used to identify the corresponding dataserver event to determine if this command succeeded or failed and the results.

key llDeleteKeyValue(string k) Start an asynchronous transaction to delete a key-value pair associated with the given experience key with the given key. Returns a handle (a key) that can be used to identify the corresponding dataserver event to determine if this command succeeded or failed and the results.
list llGetAgentList(integer scope, list options) Requests a list of agents currently in the region, limited by the scope parameter.

list llGetExperienceDetails(key experience_id) Returns a list of details about the experience. This list has 5 components: [string experience_name, key owner_id, key group_id, key experience_id, integer state, string state_message]
If experience_id is NULL_KEY, then information about the script's experience is returned. In this situation, if the script isn't associated with an experience, an empty list is returned.

string llGetExperienceErrorMessage(integer error) Returns a string describing the Experience LSL error constant passed or the string corresponding to error. Returns XP_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ERROR if the error is not a valid error code.

float llGetMaxScaleFactor() Returns the maximum multiplicative scale factor which can be used by llScaleByFactor(); i.e. such that every prim in the linkset is <=64m and the resulting linkset meets the linkability requirements
float llGetMinScaleFactor() Returns the minimum multiplicative scale factor which can be used by llScaleByFactor(); i.e. such that every prim in the linkset is >=1cm in scale
float llGetSimStats(integer stat_type) Returns the value of a particular simulator statistic.
list llJson2List(string json) Converts the top level of the json string to a list.
string llJsonGetValue(string json, list specifiers) Gets the value indicated by specifiers from the json string.
string llJsonSetValue(string json, list specifiers, string value) Returns a new json string that is the json given with the value indicated by specifiers set to value.
string llJsonValueType(string json, list specifiers) Returns the type constant for the value in json indicated by specifiers.

key llKeyCountKeyValue() Start an asynchronous transaction to request the number of keys in the system.
Returns a handle (a key) that can be used to identify the corresponding dataserver event to determine if this command succeeded or failed and the results.

key llKeysKeyValue(integer first, integer count) Start an asynchronous transaction to request a number of keys. first is a zero-based index.
Returns a handle (a key) that can be used to identify the corresponding dataserver event to determine if this command succeeded or failed. This function will attempt to retrieve the number of keys requested but may return less if there are not enough to fulfill the full amount requested or if the list is too large. The order keys are returned is not guaranteed but is stable between subsequent calls as long as no keys are added or removed.
string llList2Json(string type, list values) Converts either a strided list of key:value pairs to a JSON_OBJECT or a list of values to a JSON_ARRAY

integer llManageEstateAccess(integer action, key id) To add or remove agents from the estate's agent access or ban lists or groups from the estate's group access list. Only works for objects owned by the Estate Owner or an Estate Manager. Returns TRUE if successful and FALSE if throttled, on invalid action, on invalid or null id, or if object owner is not allowed to manage the estate. 'action' can be any of: ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_[AGENT/GROUP]_[ADD/REMOVE] or ESTATE_ACCESS_BANNED_AGENT_[ADD/REMOVE]

key llReadKeyValue(string k) Start an asynchronous transaction to read the value associated with the specified key and the specified experience. Returns a handle (a key) that can be used to identify the corresponding dataserver event to determine if this command succeeded or failed and the results.

llRequestExperiencePermissions(key agent, string name) agent is the agent to request permissions from; name is deprecated. This request is similar to llRequestPermissions with all the following permissions: PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS, PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION, PERMISSION_ATTACH, PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA, PERMISSION_CONTROL_CAMERA and PERMISSION_TELEPORT. However, unlike llRequestPermissions, the decision to allow or block the request is persistent and applies to all scripts using the experience grid-wide.
Subsequent calls to llRequestExperiencePermissions from scripts in the experience will receive the same response automatically with no user interaction.
Either experience_permissions or experience_permissions_denied will be generated in response to this call. If no response is given by the agent, the request will time out after at least 5 minutes. Multiple requests by the same script can be made during this time out though the script can only have permission for one agent at a time.
integer llReturnObjectsByID(list objects) Returns a list of objects by their IDs or an ERR_* flag.
integer llReturnObjectsByOwner(key owner, integer scope) Returns all objects of a particular owner in the given scope or an ERR_* flag.

integer llScaleByFactor(float scaling_factor) Returns a string that is a Base64 XOR of Base64-formatted input strings. Uniformly resizes the linkset by the given multiplicative scale factor (e.g. 2.0 to double the scale in all dimensions) Returns TRUE if rescaling was successful or FALSE otherwise This function only succeeds in non-physical objects

llTeleportAgent(key avatar, string landmark, vector position, vector look_at) Requests a teleport of avatar to a landmark stored in the object's inventory. If no landmark is provided (an empty string), the avatar is teleported to the location position in the current region. In either case, the avatar is turned to face the position given by look_at in local coordinates.

llTeleportAgentGlobalCoords(key agent, vector global_coordinates, vector region_coordinates, vector look_at) Teleports an agent to set of a region_coordinates within a region at the specified global_coordinates. The agent lands facing the position defined by look_at local coordinates. A region's global coordinates can be retrieved using llRequestSimulatorData(region_name, DATA_SIM_POS)

key llUpdateKeyValue(string k, string v, integer checked, string original_value) Start an asynchronous transaction to update a key-value pair associated with the given experience key with the given key and value. If checked is TRUE, the update will only happen if original_value is the value in the key-value store.
Returns a handle (a key) that can be used to identify the corresponding dataserver event to determine if this command succeeded or failed and the results.
string llXorBase64(string str1, string str2) Returns a string that is a Base64 XOR of Base64-formatted input strings.
